description: KNa₂AlH₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one KNa₂AlH₆ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(1), np.int64(0), np.int64(-1)) direction. K is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four H atoms. There are a spread of K-H bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.83 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.34 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to four H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.66 Å. Al is bonded in a water-like geometry to two H atoms. There is one shorter (1.67 Å) and one longer (1.68 Å) Al-H bond length. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one K and one H atom. The H-H bond length is 0.77 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent K and one Al atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one H atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Na atoms. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one K and two Na atoms.
